_readme: The Barred Gate opens here. Two doorways, both in walls rather than on the map's edge:
a locked warp does NOT move the player, so a gate on an open edge would leave them
standing on the last tile of the world with nothing beyond it to stop them walking off.
The east third of the map is the keep's outer wall, with the barred gate cut into it at
[11,5]. Walking into that tile while you have no key says a line and goes nowhere.
Nothing here knows what a key is. The gate names a flag, the stash in the hollow sets
one, and the only code this game has is three lines deciding which of the warden's
